verdict.rationale: The Virginia State Corporation Commission is a government business-registry and filing authority. Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user-built automations is a workflow-platform capability outside that category, so the axis does not apply. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes, which say nothing about automations and do not show the product ships such a feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
